attchmntText: DSJ Keep Learning Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: DSJ Keep Learning Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, at a Board meeting on November 14, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 192.54 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net profit of 3.44 lakh rupees in the same period of the previous year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net profit was 182.18 lakh rupees, versus 33.46 lakh rupees in the prior year. Revenue from operations stood at 154.60 lakh rupees for the quarter and 365.85 lakh rupees for the half year. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified limited review report on these results. The financial statements were prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards.
